evidencePolicy.reference: fixture.json expectedStatus plus the pinned oracle.json snapshot
evidencePolicy.native: An implementation-local invariant or an explicitly recorded known gap; native behavior is never used to create reference evidence.
evidencePolicy.classification: match, known-gap, and unsupported are expected relationships. unexpected-divergence, regression, and inconclusive are produced by the runner.
